title: Participant left
description: A participant left a room — or the room ended, moved to another pod, or evicted their session; `reason` says which. The `data` of a `fi.ioio.gawk.room.participant_left` CloudEvent.

reason.description: Why the session ended. `left` is somebody leaving; the other three are the room happening to them — `room_ended` follows a room.closed, `home_moved` follows a room.home_changed from the new home and the same people rejoin there, `timeout` is an evicted control session. Absent means `left`.
